decisions.reason: As a flagship biodynamic yogurt that extends the firm's established organic dairy and Demeter know-how, it fits its strongest knowledge base and is therefore a product the firm is well placed to refine rather than withdraw.

Mild sliced cheese is close to the firm's existing cheesemaking capabilities and supplier base, so early market feedback can be absorbed and used for incremental improvement with limited strategic risk.
Sliced butter cheese also builds directly on the firm's core dairy processing and cheese expertise, making it more likely that the firm will keep and optimize it than remove it after only one year.
